name: 68420 · Pawnee City, NE
findings: ZIP 68420 (Pawnee City) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68420 (Pawnee City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
